goal: Establish strict deterministic compatibility contracts for an intent-compiled ephemeral spatial workspace and freeze the Coding Spatial Workspace vertical slice without operational behavior.
positive_requirements: Wrap and independently verify, but never replace, AURA_EPHEMERAL_ORGAN_V1.
Require lossless JSON canonicalization and non-empty serialized record digests.
Retain only closed scalar metadata and exact references to canonical truth owners.
Require complete current project, adapter, evidence, scene, session, and entity bindings.
Freeze CODING_SPATIAL_WORKSPACE_V1 capabilities, graph, handoff owners, gates, actions, lifecycle, and dissolution policy.
Publish Draft 2020-12 structural schemas plus named mandatory semantic validators.
Cover every accepted external review finding with a regression test.
negative_requirements: Do not modify existing V1 manifest, Spatial, Compass, Forge, memory, runtime, renderer, or domain-owner source.
Do not create a project database, persistence store, second router, second renderer, second verifier, or second execution plane.
Do not coerce malformed keys, text, numbers, sets, digests, or Git identities into valid records.
Do not retain unknown, nested, authority-bearing, or raw-sensor metadata.
Do not grant patch, execution, persistence, deployment, physical-work, payment, professional, model, sensor, renderer, commit, push, pull-request, or merge authority.
Do not regenerate or retain CODEMAP/topology changes in this substantive PR.
exit_gates: Existing V1 manifest object and digest remain unchanged when wrapped.
Serialized V1 manifest content is independently recomputed and verified.
Every serialized new record requires and verifies its original 64-character digest.
Unknown metadata, non-string keys, sets, malformed types, and raw-sensor aliases fail closed.
Project and observation validators require complete expected identity sets.
The frozen capability graph, owners, gates, lifecycle, and dissolution policy cannot be substituted.
Recipe TTL and wall-time budget cannot outlive the wrapped V1 manifest.
All schemas meta-validate and name mandatory semantic validators for cross-field invariants.
Generated navigation artifacts are identical to the exact base.
